breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflicting instructions. The original prompt incorrectly listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting' as the numerical method. The ground truth correctly removed the 'Explicit forward Euler' line. The agent's generated specification repeated the error by including both conflicting methods: 'Time integration: Explicit forward Euler' and 'Method: Strang splitting'.
